RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the April 30, 2008/Vaisakha 10, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home
Affairs; Information and Broadcasting; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Science and
Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
165
Extension of NREGS benefits to
farming community
*521. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
extend National Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme (NREGS) benefits to
the farming community;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
grant labour subsidy to the farmers to work
on their own fields to help control migration
from rural areas and to address their distress;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Management support to rural
development programmes
*522. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has introduced
management support to rural development
programmes and strengthening of district
planning process from financial year
2007-08;
(b) whether the scheme primarily focuses
on training and skill development of rural
development functionaries and members of
Panchayati Raj Institutions in rural
development at Centre, State and district/
block level by providing financial support
to State Institutes of Rural Development
and Extension Training Centres;
(c) if so, whether Government proposes
to create awareness amongst targeted
groups of rural development programmes
and mobilize them towards participatory
development programme sensitizing
opinion making; and
(d) if so, the extent of this scheme’s
implementation and helpfulness?

166
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Designing of software by TCS on
NREG programme
*523. SHRI MATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a specially
designed software has been prepared by
Tata Consultancy Service Social Sector
team, which helps in tracking every detail
in NREGA Scheme;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this
software has been successfully used in
Andhra Pradesh to prevent misuse of funds
meant for implementation of NREGA
Scheme;
(c) if so, the details of the said software;
and
(d) what steps Government propose to
take to use this software in the entire
country?
Persons still detained under TADA
*524. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) how many persons are still detained
under TADA in the country;
(b) the break-up, State-wise and
religion-wise; and
(c) whether after repealing of TADA,
confinement under this law is legal?
Inspection report of Admiral Gorshkov
*525. SHRI  M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the inspection of Admiral
Gorshkov which was to be completed by
March, 2008 is over;
(b) if so, the details of inspection report;
(c) whether it is a fact that Russia has
made it clear to the Ministry that cost
escalation of Admiral Gorshkov is a must;
and
(d) if so, what is the price escalation
Russia has proposed and to what extent
Government has agreed to give?
Findings in Tenkasi bomb blast case
*526. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the findings of the police
investigation in Tenkasi bomb blast case;
(b) its implications on the national
security; and
(c) whether it is a fact that similar blasts
were conducted in Nanded and parcel bombs
in Maharashtra?
Steps to increase strength of women
in army
†*527. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the percentage of women in the army
at present;
(b) whether Government proposes to
increase the percentage of women in the
army; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Custodial deaths in the country
*528. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state the total number of custodial deaths
occurred in various police stations in the
country during the last two years, State-
wise?

167
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
ILO report on unemployment forecast
*529. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of LABOUR
AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the International Labour
Organisation (ILO) in its recent report has
revealed that there will be unemployment
of estimated 5 million in 2008;
(b) if so, the likely unemployment in
India as per the said report;
(c) whether the unemployment rate in
the country is increasing alarmingly and
the steps taken by Government to provide
jobs have not proved effective; and
(d) if so, the strategies to be adopted to
face the challenges of unemployment in the
country?
